status: Proposed 2026-11-12; not yet loaded. Load with manage.py load_access_overrides (dry run, then --confirm after the owner confirms this file), then rebuild.
annotations: Patuxent Research Refuge, North Tract (Anne Arundel County): the southern stretch of Whip-poor-will Way, way 85508536 (0.71 mi, 1,150 m), from the Sweetgum Lane junction east to the rest of Whip-poor-will Way. OSM tags it access=permit and bicycle=permit, so the map hid it (facility.map_class: a road the public may not enter) and routes could not use it, though the rest of Whip-poor-will Way, which carries bicycle=yes, is drawn and open. The refuge's own June 2026 map shows the whole of Whip-poor-will Way as a walk, bike and horse road and names no permit for it, so the permit tags read as out of date. Opened with a bicycle=yes access row. Two pieces of South Road with the same tags (ways 707456988 and 707645386) are left closed: they run on past Wildlife Way into the area the refuge closed on 2026-06-07.

rows.reason: The owner, 2026-11-12, of the refuge's roads on our map: "Most of the pautuxet research refuge is now closed to bikes on the map, but it's a very common route for biking", and of the undrawn stretches: "It's the white parts that concerns me." The refuge's map marks Whip-poor-will Way for walking, biking and horseback riding with no permit named, and the stretches either side of this one are already tagged bicycle=yes.
rows.evidence: The owner's report, 2026-11-12. U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, North Tract trail map (June 2026): Whip-poor-will Way drawn in the legend's "Walk, Bike, Horse" style (https://www.fws.gov/sites/default/files/documents/2026-06/north-tract-trail-map_2026_time-change.pdf). FWS refuge activities page, read 2026-11-12: "Our refuge maps show the trails where bike-riding is allowed" (https://www.fws.gov/refuge/patuxent-research/visit-us/activities). OSM, read 2026-11-12: way 85508536 (version 9), highway=track, name=Whip-poor-will Way, access=permit, bicycle=permit, foot=permit, motor_vehicle=private; it joins Whip-poor-will Way 1281260248 (bicycle=yes) at its east end and Sweetgum Lane 11507213 and 707450195 (bicycle=yes) at its west end. The North Tract is open to the public on Sundays only, 8 AM to 4 PM (https://www.fws.gov/refuge/patuxent-research); this row does not model those hours.
